{{Top}}
'''Bioluminescence''' was the production and emission of light by a living organism. Bioluminescent flora existed in [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst's]] oceans and on [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], which also had an array of bioluminescent fauna who adapted to the constant darkness of the planet.
